boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office at Live Oak Bank Pavilion will open on show days at 10:00 a.m. The box office will also be open on Fridays from 10 am to 4 pm only when a show is going on sale to the general public. If no shows are going on sale on a particular Friday, the box office will remain closed. For more information on our box office hours, send us a message on our social pages. To purchase tickets, please visit us at www.livenation.com. We look forward to seeing you at our next show at Live Oak Bank Pavilion.

venues.parkingDetail: There is no on site parking at Live Oak Bank Pavilion, however, there are several publicly owned parking decks nearby as well as metered street parking. If you are getting a ride to the show, there is a drop off point that is located at the top of Harnett St. and Front St.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available on a first come first served basis. Accessible tickets can be purchased online via www.livenation.com. Look for the accessible logo on the Find Tickets page to view all available accessible seats. Live Oak Bank Pavilion meets all ADA requirements regarding accessibility, concessions, restrooms and viewing area for the show. For more information, visit Liveoakbankpav.com/accessibility

events.name: The Cellar, Sea & Shore
events.description:
Looking for a night to remember?
Join us for the Cellar, Sea & Shore!
 
An unforgettable evening of fine wines, craft brews, and coastal cuisine — with live music, local flavors, and the vibrant spirit of Wilmington.—it's a night out—presented by Lighthouse Beer and Wine

Think specialty craft beers, full wine bars, oysters, and amazing chefs presenting delectable delights! This is an event for the true aficionado of life to try new things. Please mark your calendars for October 23, 2026 and join us as the sun sets on the river!

Lighthouse Beer and Wine presents a night out, the Cellar, Sea and Shore, a beer, wine, oysters, and food event, where the most incredible & fantastic brewery and winery representatives pour their most sought-after selections.  This is the ultimate fermented beverage experience. Tickets are extremely limited, so please get yours in hand as soon as you can. This evening includes oysters and tasty bites from select local restaurants!


As always, this event is for a cause—benefiting The Carousel Child Advocacy Center, a non-profit organization committed to assisting victims of child abuse and providing critical care services to children from throughout southeastern North Carolina. The Lighthouse Beer and Wine Festival has become integral to the Carousel Center’s yearly budget. This festival helps the Carousel Center continue to support those in need in our surrounding counties and cities.

events.name: Lighthouse Beer and Wine Festival
events.description:
October 24th, 2026
Join us for the Lighthouse Beer and Wine Festival, benefitting the Carousel Child Advocacy Center!

Welcome to the Premiere Beer & Wine event in the Southeast!
It's not to be missed. Get your tickets to the largest beer and wine festival in the southeast! The most extensive variety of beers from more breweries than you can ever taste, jammin' live music, food, and wonderful people like you make this event unlike any other. We want you to find exciting new beverages you’ll love to sip. We promise you’ll hone your hop-tasting, tickle your tongue, and have the best beer and wine-tasting day of the year. There’s no better way to try all the best beer and wine and THC beverages available.

Tickets sell out fast. VIP tickets are even more limited and sell out even quicker. Be on top of your game and get them early! Read more here if you'd like.

This event is in downtown Wilmington at the Live Oak Pavilion in Riverfront Park. It’s the most fantastic time ever, and it's in the most beautiful location we can possibly imagine. It’s the best day of the year, and we can't wait to see you there.

As always, this festival is for a cause--benefiting The Carousel Child Advocacy Center, the Wilmington-based non-profit organization committed to assisting victims of child abuse and providing critical care services to children from throughout southeastern North Carolina. The Lighthouse Beer and Wine Festival has become integral to the Carousel Child Advocacy Center’s yearly budget. This festival helps the Carousel Child Advocacy Center continue to help those in need in our surrounding counties and cities.

One Session. 150 different vendors. Live music, food trucks, and all the fun. Join us on October 24th, 2026.
